title: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
abstract: arXiv:2611.29006v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The decay exponent $\alpha$ in KV-cache eviction is an intrinsic property of the model: calibrated once on a single corpus, it transfers directly across domains. Attention-based accumulation (H2O) and recency-based sliding windows (StreamingLLM) are two dominant eviction frameworks, often treated as unrelated, but we show that they are the two endpoints of a single power-law family: by scoring each token as $s_i = A_i \cdot (t-i)^{-\alpha}$, where $A_i$ is cumulative attention and $\alpha$ controls the age penalty, H2O and StreamingLLM correspond to $\alpha=0$ and $\alpha\to\infty$, respectively (with StreamingLLM additionally hard-coding an attention-sink patch).   The no-hair mechanism of \citet{xiang2026nohair} bounds the admissible range of $\alpha$, and the measured exponents agree: calibrating once on WikiText yields $[0.556, 0.822]$ for a representative model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). translated_title: NoHairCache：基于单一幂律指数的一次性校准KV缓存驱逐方法
translated_abstract: KV缓存驱逐中的衰减指数α是模型的内在属性：只需在单一语料库上校准一次，即可直接跨领域迁移使用。基于注意力累积的方法（H2O）和基于新近性的滑动窗口方法（StreamingLLM）是两种主流的驱逐框架，通常被视为互不相关，但我们证明它们其实是同一个幂律族的两个端点：通过为每个token评分 s_i = A_i · (t-i)^{-α}，其中A_i为累积注意力，α控制时间衰减惩罚，H2O和StreamingLLM分别对应于α=0和α→∞两种极限情况（StreamingLLM还额外硬编码了注意力汇聚补丁）。no-hair机制限定了α的允许取值范围，且实测指数与之吻合：在WikiText上校准一次后，代表性模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct）得到的范围为[0.556, 0.822]。各模型的指数范围在不同领域间保持一致……
tldr: 该论文证明KV缓存驱逐中的衰减指数α是模型内在属性、只需在单一语料上校准一次即可跨领域迁移，并将H2O与StreamingLLM两大主流方法统一为同一幂律评分族的两个端点。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the decay exponent α in KV-cache eviction is a model-intrinsic property that transfers across domains after one-time calibration on a single corpus, unifying H2O and StreamingLLM as the two endpoints (α=0 and α→∞) of a single power-law scoring family.
